violations.explanation: Zoom in/out is only available via double-tap and pinch gestures. There is no semantic action, button, or keyboard alternative, so screen reader, switch, and keyboard users cannot zoom or reset zoom. Double-tap is also intercepted by screen readers as the activation gesture.
The zoomable area has no Semantics label, hint, or custom actions describing that it can be zoomed or panned, and the zoom state is not announced to assistive technologies.

violations.type: Animation does not respect reduced motion preference
violations.explanation: The zoom animation runs regardless of MediaQuery.disableAnimations, which may affect users sensitive to motion.
